crossRefs.note: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will…
So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight…
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will…
So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground…
After they had departed, they came up out of the well, and went and told king David; and they said to David, “Arise and…

translations.web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
translations.bsb: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
translations.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
translations.asv: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
